materials.title: Gathering materials
materials.text: Before we start commenting on the structure and graphics of the website, it is good to have something to build on. For example a logo for the graphic layout, photos, a link to your current website, etc. In the meantime, I will analyze your field of business.

review.title: Feedback
review.text: Let's get creating! In this phase I work on the structure and design of your website. In the first version I create what I consider the ideal solution. Then I incorporate your feedback, or try to explain why some things are better solved a little differently.

build.title: Building the approved version
build.text: Once everything is approved, I get to work. Simpler projects are usually finished within a few days, while more complex projects can take several weeks.

launch.title: Launch
launch.text: Before we launch the website, we go through everything thoroughly. For example the e-shop functionality, how article content is managed, etc. Once the last details are fine-tuned, nothing stands in the way of launching and handing over the website, including complete documentation.
